g.text: Solar capacity per season-year: fitted against experiment 45

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Capacity of embedded solar in MW. The convex model fits one non-decreasing capacity per season- year; experiment 45's real-time vintage is the weekly estimate made with data to June 2025, and its hindsight constant is fitted on whole years.'
text.tspan: Capacity of embedded solar in MW. The convex model fits one non-decreasing capacity per season-
year; experiment 45's real-time vintage is the weekly estimate made with data to June 2025, and
its hindsight constant is fitted on whole years.
